Sarah: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the Q2 planning meeting.
Mike: Morning Sarah. I've got the preliminary numbers ready.
Sarah: Great. So first, let's talk about the product roadmap. Where are we on the mobile app launch?
Mike: We're making progress. The iOS version is about 70% done, and Android is maybe around 50%.
Sarah: What's the timeline looking like?
Mike: We should probably be able to launch by end of June. Maybe early July.
Lisa: Actually, I thought we agreed last week that the launch would be in May? I have it in my notes.
Mike: Well, that was the initial target, but things have shifted. We'll see how it goes.
Sarah: OK, so we need clarity on this. Mike, can you confirm the launch date by Friday?
Mike: I'll try to get back to you on that. At some point this week hopefully.
Sarah: Let's make it definitive. Lisa, what about the marketing campaign?
Lisa: We've been working on the social media strategy. It's coming along.
Sarah: Can you be more specific? What's the budget and timeline?
Lisa: The budget is $15,000 for social ads. We're planning to start the campaign two weeks before launch.
Sarah: That sounds good. Who's handling the email marketing piece?
Lisa: Someone should probably take that on. We need to look into it.
Sarah: That's not clear enough. Let me assign that. David, can you own the email marketing campaign?
David: Sure, I can handle that. I'll have a draft ready by next Wednesday.
Sarah: Perfect. Now, about the customer feedback from last quarter. David, what were the main themes?
David: The biggest complaint was about loading times. Users said the app was slow.
Mike: That's interesting because we actually optimized the backend last month. Performance should be 40% faster now.
David: Well, the feedback I got last week still mentions slowness. So either the fix isn't deployed or it's not enough.
Mike: It's definitely deployed. The metrics show improvement. Maybe the users haven't noticed yet.
Sarah: This seems contradictory. Can someone verify the actual production metrics versus user sentiment? Mike, can you pull those numbers?
Mike: Yeah, I'll look into that. Eventually.
Sarah: I need those numbers by Thursday, not eventually. Let's also discuss the partnership with Acme Corp.
Lisa: The Acme partnership is basically done. We're just waiting on legal review.
David: Wait, I spoke with Acme yesterday and they said they have concerns about the pricing model. They might not sign.
Lisa: That's not what I heard from their VP last week. She said everything was on track.
Sarah: So we have conflicting information about Acme. Lisa, can you set up a call with their team this week to resolve this?
Lisa: I'll try to arrange something. Hopefully by Friday.
Sarah: Let's make it by Wednesday. OK, final item. The team offsite. Any updates?
David: I'm looking into venues. There are some options but nothing confirmed yet.
Sarah: When will we have a confirmed venue?
David: At some point next week, I think. There are a lot of options to consider.

David: I'll do my best.
Sarah: Alright, let's wrap up. To summarize: Mike will confirm the launch date by Friday and pull performance metrics by Thursday.
